top_findings.title: Standings double-count seasons present in both Brasileirão sources
top_findings.evidence: query.ex:74-75 standings/3 filters competition via exact_or_contains? (query.ex:119-122, a substring match); search_key("Brasileirão Historical") contains search_key("Brasileirão"), so the default competition matches both Brasileirao_Matches.csv and novo_campeonato_brasileiro.csv (catalog.ex:10). Both CSVs hold 380 rows for 2019 and each gives Flamengo 90pts/38 games; team_key merges Flamengo-RJ/Flamengo -> ~180pts/76 games. _factual.json score 0.0.
top_findings.suggestion: Match competition exactly (or map each source to a canonical competition id) and/or deduplicate overlapping match sources so a season is aggregated once.
